messages:
joel: Quick design sync 1: compact diff approval flow for Prompt Sets. Usability research found reviewers lose context when diffs collapse too aggressively. We need to balance density with clarity.

mira: Agreed. Current compact mode hides the prompt body behind a chevron; that makes approvals feel blind. Proposal: keep a single-line truncated preview but surface a keyboard-activatable focused inline expansion (not modal).

sam: Accessibility: inline expansion must be a real element (button with aria-expanded) so screen readers announce state. Avoid dialogs that steal focus unless explicitly requested.

toni: Microcopy: the approve CTA currently says "Approve change" which isn't clear when multiple diffs are selected. Suggest "Approve selected changes" and for single-item quick-approve use "Approve example".

joel: Good catch. Also, for bulk approves, we need a lightweight confirmation only when the selection > 50 examples (to avoid accidental mass approvals). Confirm dialog should list counts not names.

mira: Visual suggestion: when compact mode is on, show a subtle affordance — a left border color strip indicating severity (green/yellow/red) and a hover tooltip showing the first failure snippet. That keeps rows tight but gives quick signal.

sam: Keyboard nav: Enter toggles expansion when on a focused row, Space toggles selection checkbox, Shift+Enter toggles bulk select from last focused row to current. Add a sr-only help text: "Enter to expand, Space to select".

toni: For acceptance copy in confirmation: "You're about to approve 243 examples. This will mark these evals as reviewed and update scorecards." CTA: "Confirm approve" / secondary: "Cancel". Keep language action-first.

i18n-bot: i18n-scan: "Approve selected changes" and "Approve example" map differently in some languages. Flag to provide separate translation keys for single vs multi. Also note pluralization for counts in the confirmation.

access-bot: a11y-check: ensure the inline expansion is reachable via skip links and that changes to layout do not reflow keyboard focus unpredictably. Also recommend providing `aria-live="polite"` region for approval result ("243 examples approved").

joel: Edge case: when the user has filters active (e.g., only failing examples), bulk approve should show a subtle badge "Approving filtered set" and allow users to switch to "All results" in the confirm step.

mira: Performance: avoid rendering full prompt bodies for all rows. Render full text only for expanded rows, and render a safe truncated preview server-side to avoid layout shifts. Use CSS `text-overflow: ellipsis` and `white-space: nowrap` for previews.

sam: Screen reader phrasing for collapsed row: use `aria-label="Prompt: {short text}. Status: regressed, delta +2.1. Press Enter to expand details."` so users get essential info without expanding.

toni: Another microcopy tweak: change 'Regressed' -> 'Shows regression' in the row summary to be present-tense and more descriptive.

joel: Decision proposal: add compact-mode inline expansion (button with aria-expanded), adjust CTAs for single vs bulk approve, add a threshold confirmation for large bulk actions (>50), surface severity strip, keyboard shortcuts (Enter/Space/Shift+Enter), i18n keys for single/multi, use aria-live for results, and keep full prompt text off-DOM until expansion.

mira: UX detail: when expanding inline, show contextual actions (approve, request changes, comment) pinned to the right of the expanded panel; they should stay visible when the panel scrolls out of viewport using `position: sticky`.

sam: Implementation note: sticky controls need fallbacks for Safari; test with various overflow containers. Also ensure `position: sticky` doesn't trap focus.

toni: Copy for action buttons: Approve example / Request changes / Add comment. For bulk: Approve selected changes / Request changes for selected. Keep verbs consistent.

i18n-bot: Also flag 'Request changes' vs 'Request change' plurality. Use single translation key with count context.

access-bot: Add to checklist: keyboard shortcuts docs, aria-expanded on expansion button, aria-live for result, confirmation dialog with role=dialog and focus trap, and ensure color indicators are backed by text/tooltip for colorblind users.

joel: Action items: @mira build design + prototype, @sam add accessibility attributes and keyboard handling, @toni update copy and i18n keys, @joel add confirmation cadence and threshold to product spec.

mira: I'll post interactive prototype by EOD Wednesday and include a quick keyboard demo GIF.

joel: Thanks all 61; final note: let's keep compact mode default off for new users but allow power users to set it in prefs.
